title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G036
note: Single-case regression for completed-order counts grouped by customer country, output alias, and alphabetical ordering.

cases.question: Show completed order counts for each customer country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;
